QUOTE: The index's thread layer finds four spawn sites, all in `programs/` (`ssl_pthread_server.c:277`, `ssl_server2.c:1699`, `benchmark.c:430/444`). None is in `library/`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states no thread is created in library/, but never says library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It says the layer is opt-in and off by default, and it describes `threading.c` only as a gated backend.
